Internship must be technical or STEM-focused.
Internship must provide at least 120 hours of work per semester.
Intern must have a cumulative GPA of 2.5 or higher.
Intern must be a student at a Maryland college, a Maryland resident attending an out-of-state college, or a recent graduate of a Maryland college.
structured_extraction.application_process_overview: First, the employer submits an application and a technical internship description for review. Once approved, new employers must attend an online orientation. The employer then hires an eligible intern and places them on their payroll. After the internship ends, the employer completes an evaluation and submits a request for wage reimbursement.
